verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel has a start-up and small-business practice and describes a university-incubator J-1 pathway. However, nothing in the evidence explains how a founder's own company can petition for them. There is no coverage of beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer-control arrangements, or the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance. The incubator route relies on a university sponsor rather than the founder's own startup, and the generic start-up pages only offer consultations.
